title: A Comprehensive Survey in LLM(-Agent) Full Stack Safety: Data, Training and Deployment

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed evaluation frameworks and benchmarks that measure gender bias using template-based prompts, toxicity and regard metrics for text models, as well as parallel image sets, counterfactual probing, and real-world dataset imbalances for multimodal models.
Surveyed benchmarks that assess racial bias across text and multimodal AI systems leveraging template-based prompting, counterfactual probing, and stereotyping/toxicity metrics.
Examined text-based evaluation benchmarks (such as ROBBIE) that quantify religious bias by testing models across demographic axes using template-based prompts and regard metrics.

Highlighted frameworks that measure bias across overlapping demographic dimensions (e.g., combinations of gender and race) utilizing parallel image sets, counterfactual probing, and templated prompts.
